name: DatePicker

knownIssues.summary: It doesn't pass its calendar's previousMonthLabel, nextMonthLabel, previousYearLabel, and nextYearLabel through, so they stay English here and in Date Time Picker (built-in-labels).

purpose: Enter a single date via a field that opens a calendar popup.
intent: A read-only date field (Text Field trigger) that opens the Date Picker Calendar in a Popup.

figmaSource.variants: context (default | inline) x size (sm | md | lg) x state (default | filled | hover | open | disabled)

parts.trigger: figma-parts / select-trigger wrapping a text-field (value text + elemAfterInput calendar icon); the field frame is radius md with a border/input outline.
parts.popup: the Figma trigger is built inside a dropdown-menu > popup (surface slot = the calendar). In code the trigger composes the Popup primitive + Text Field directly (dropdown-menu is menu-specific); the calendar goes in Popup's content.

figmaSource.notes: context passes straight to the Text Field's own context: 'default' (bordered); 'inline' (borderless), matching the text-field's context=inline variant. The 'open' state is rendered by pinning the field focus treatment (data-force-state='focus'): a border/focus box for default, a border/focus underline for inline. 'filled' is just the value-present field. Field is read-only (v1); manual date entry is future.

useCases: a date field in a form
any single-date entry that benefits from a calendar
antiPatterns: an always-visible inline calendar (use Date Picker Calendar directly)
time selection (use Time Picker / Date-Time Picker)
a small set of preset dates (use Select)

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: wrapper; defaults to a 240px field width, shrinks to its container

anatomy.name: trigger
anatomy.description: read-only date display + trailing calendar icon; aria-haspopup=dialog

anatomy.name: popup
anatomy.description: anchored to the field frame; holds the calendar, which is the named role=dialog

anatomy.name: calendar
anatomy.description: the month grid inside the popup

alignment.description: Popup's alignment. The deprecated physical names (bottomLeft, ...) are still accepted.

required.description: Native required on the input, plus a hidden input the form's validation checks (a read-only input is never validated).

dialogLabel.description: Accessible name for the calendar dialog.

semantic.popupPadding: none (the calendar provides its own padding)

tokens.note: Field surface/border/typography come from Text Field; the calendar and popup carry their own tokens. Date Picker adds only the trigger cursor/icon and the 240px default width.

accessibility.expanded: aria-expanded, and aria-controls pointing at the dialog while open, set by Date Picker
accessibility.panelRole: dialog (the calendar root), named by dialogLabel
accessibility.openFocus: focus moves into the calendar grid on open, once the panel is shown
accessibility.dismiss: Escape, selecting a day, or Tab / Shift+Tab out of the calendar closes and returns focus to the field; outside click dismisses without moving focus
accessibility.required: native required on the read-only input, plus a hidden input (tabIndex -1, aria-hidden) that the form's constraint validation checks; focusing it sends focus on to the field
accessibility.calendar: the DatePickerCalendar provides the grid semantics and keyboard model

keyboardInteraction: Enter / Space / ArrowDown / ArrowUp open the popup from the field.
Escape closes the popup and returns focus to the field.
Tab past the calendar's last stop, or Shift+Tab before its first, closes it and returns focus to the field.
Inside the popup, the calendar's grid keyboard model applies.
behaviorRules: Inside a disabled <fieldset>, the input is disabled without the disabled prop; the field looks disabled (Text Field's :has(.input:disabled)) and the panel doesn't open by click or key.
Render a read-only Text Field showing the formatted selected date + a calendar icon.
context passes straight to the Text Field's context (default | inline); size passes through.
Render the open state by pinning the field focus treatment while open.
Open the calendar in a Popup anchored to the field frame; select fills the field and closes.
compositionRules: Compose the Text Field molecule (trigger), the Popup primitive (positioning/dismissal), and the Date Picker Calendar (content).
Give the field an accessible name (aria-label or aria-labelledby).
contentRules: Format the date with `format` / `locale`; provide a placeholder for the empty state.
responsiveRules: The field defaults to 240px and shrinks to its container.
The popup hugs the calendar's fixed width and repositions to avoid viewport overflow.
themeRules: Field, popup, and calendar use semantic tokens; do not reference primitives directly.
Dark theme is supported through the generated token variables.
implementationNotes: React and TypeScript; React.forwardRef on the root.
CSS Modules; compose Text Field + Popup + Date Picker Calendar.
No MUI, no Tailwind, no hardcoded colors/typography/spacing.
Read-only field (v1); manual date entry is a future addition.
do: Use for single-date entry in forms and filters.
Give the field an accessible name and a placeholder.
Constrain dates with min/max or isDateDisabled.
Use inline context on dense or borderless surfaces.
dont: Use for an always-visible calendar (use Date Picker Calendar).
acceptanceCriteria: Renders a field with the formatted selected date and a closed popup.
Opens the calendar on click / Enter / Arrow Down and marks the field expanded.
Moves focus into the calendar on open.
Selects a day: fills the field, closes, returns focus (uncontrolled); supports controlled value.
Closes on Escape and returns focus to the field.
Passes min/max through to the calendar; points aria-controls at a dialog named by dialogLabel.
Tab / Shift+Tab out of the calendar closes it and returns focus to the field.
A required, empty Date Picker fails the form's validation; a date or disabled passes.
Does not use MUI or Tailwind.
